subject: BNB8 timing baseline frozen for TorchAO sanity check
body: Lane B extracted Lane A's existing nonpaged BNB8 timing receipts as a sanity baseline for the queued TorchAO step. Step1 rows0-7 elapsed 119.554 s. Eight-step continuation rows32-95 elapsed 877.414 s (~109.68 s/step). Eight-step continuation rows96-159 elapsed 689.964 s (~86.25 s/step). Optimizer state was consistently 16.632 MiB. These are NOT a matched runtime/row comparison and must not be used to claim TorchAO speedup; they are only a pathology bound because TorchAO AdamW8bit internally torch.compile()s its per-parameter update. The later matched same-start/same-rows BNB8 control remains required before any optimizer promotion.
